name: Confirm Modal UI
description: Generic confirmation dialog with message, Cancel, and confirm button.

dom.root: .confirm-overlay (position: fixed, inset: 0, background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6), display: flex, align-items: center, justify-content: center, z-index: 10000)
children: .confirm-modal (background: var(--surface), border: 1px dashed var(--border), border-radius: 8px, padding: 24px, min-width: 300px, max-width: 450px)
.confirm-message (margin-bottom: 20px, font-size: 14px, line-height: 1.5, allows HTML content via innerHTML)
.confirm-ok (button: default 'Delete' or custom label, primary/danger styling)

interactions.name: confirm
interactions.action: Resolve promise with true → Remove overlay from DOM

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.action: Resolve promise with false → Remove overlay from DOM

interactions.name: dismiss
interactions.action: Resolve promise with false → Remove overlay from DOM

states.open: Overlay visible, message displayed, Cancel and confirm buttons rendered
